purpose: Falsify common number-selection heuristics under an exactly uniform 00000-99999 draw before spending effort on historical pattern mining.
keyFinding: The apparent batch-1 ending-26 anomaly (z≈3.22) reversed to ordinary noise in the independent second batch (z≈-0.54). None of the tested number-shape heuristics replicated as a directional advantage.
nextResearch: Prioritize structured pre-draw observables that can differ in the real purchasing environment: TuLotero inventory state, disappearance velocity, outlet count, administration concentration, SELAE allocation/subscribed-number mechanism, channel availability and exposure-normalized prospective tests.
